text: This is what I thought his name came from, from KP's question yesterday, since he had mentioned he hunted tigers
But in reality, those tigers were captured by his minions for him to shoot
or staged so that the tiger would have no real way of getting away from being killed by the Nizam
So Tees Maar Khan is a name people used to indicate his boastfulness
in Hyderabad, it's used for a guy who is boastful about his exploits
